title: Can I get my bill in a different language or in large print?
content:
Question: Can I get my bill in a different language or in large print?

Answer: Yes. Bill language preference (English/Hindi/regional) can be set under Profile > Communication Preferences. For visually-impaired customers, NovaTel offers large-print and audio bill formats — see the Accessibility Services section of the app.

Topic: Billing & Invoices
